synopsis: In West Ward Vaan's vision of Reks and the Dusk Shard (黄昏の破片): Vaan shows his brother the stone and talks of buying an airship, over nine cuts to Abandoning Power (track 39). Authored text (its entries are Vaan's and Reks's lines in Japanese: "Look, brother, I bet it's worth a fortune" / "I'll sell it, buy an airship and become a sky pirate!" / "This will make [a word the dump drops] come true, so even on my own..." / "Brother!?" / "Brother!"): 見ろよ兄さん きっとすごい値打ちもんだよ / これ売った金で飛空艇買って オレ空賊になるんだ！ / こいつがをかなえてくれる だからオレもうひとりでも / 兄さん！？ / 兄さん！ / Skip
